The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 c6e7116ea33f29ee), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. statement: Let γ be ordinary chordal SLEκ from 0 to ∞ in H, parametrized by half-plane capacity 2t, and set Γ = γ([0, ∞)). For each fixed 0 < κ < 8, on one event of probability one, 0 < Hh (γ([s, t])) < ∞ for every real 0 < s < t < ∞. For every deterministic 0 < R < ∞, EHh (Γ ∩ B(0, R)) ≤ Cκ,R < ∞. In particular, on the same probability-one event, Hh Γ ∩ ([−m, m] + i[0, m])  < ∞ (m = 1, 2, . . .).
